main.description: Religious-corp social post. AT Protocol record under the writer's DID (typically an SBT-holding adherent), carrying short-form text + optional reply chain. The substrate pipeline (mst-projector → ipfs-pinner → anchor-cron) anchors the writer's MST root including these posts, so any third party can verify the post existed at a given moment without trusting this operator. Distinct from `app.bsky.feed.post`: religious-corp namespace lives at `com.etzhayyim.apps.threads.*`, SBT-gated write policy is enforced at the PDS layer (not in this lexicon), and the embed surface is intentionally narrow in v1 — no media, no external link unfurl, no quote-post — to bias the medium toward attestation and study over performance. Per ADR-2605172000 substrate posture.

text.description: Primary post content. May be empty when `reply` is present (e.g. silent witness).

reply.description: Reply target — required `root` (thread origin) + `parent` (immediate parent). Both fields point to existing com.etzhayyim.apps.threads.post records.

langs.description: BCP-47 language tags for the primary text (e.g. 'ja', 'en'). Empty = unspecified.

tags.description: Author-chosen tags. Distinct from hashtags inline in text. Bounded so the substrate doesn't carry unbounded payloads.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when the post was originally written.

root.description: Root of the thread — the first post in the conversation.

parent.description: Immediate parent post — the one this post is replying to. May equal `root` when replying to the thread origin.
